policy.scope: Post-processing of N16/N20/N24 boosted refined-core results from this user instruction onward
policy.missing_mass_policy: Preserve gaps; never substitute coordinate radius for areal radius or infer missing masses
policy.qualification: Post expansion-quality selection is distinct from full native finder acceptance: the native mass-stationarity criterion is not recorded for rejected candidates. Re-evaluate saved admitted endpoint geometry offline with RMS tolerance 0.01 when needed, preserving other finder controls and original evidence.
